Shows names of landowners. The Earliest Map of Morristown, New Jersey, Smith, Marcus/ Dripps, M. [New York: 1850] Map of Morristown, Morris County, N.J. 38 1/2x30 inches. Hand-colored, lithographed small wall map. Expertly conserved & re-mounted on new linen with silk edging. Evidence of previous cracking & a few small losses at top & bottom portions, lightly age-toned, overall a superior example for map of this type.
